tasks.short: Analyze premium, reserve and liability requirements

steps.what: Reconcile policy, claim and financial data for the premium and reserve analysis
outputs: reconciled analysis dataset and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Select appropriate actuarial assumptions and methods for premium, cash reserve and liability estimates
inputs: reconciled analysis dataset and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Configure analysis inputs and scenarios and calculate premium, reserve and liability estimates in the actuarial engine
inputs: reconciled analysis dataset and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Interpret estimates, sensitivity and data limitations to determine required premium rates, reserves and liabilities
inputs: reconciled analysis dataset and unresolved exceptions

tasks.design: Test native import reconciliation in {DATA_PLATFORM} and reusable scenario configurations in the actuarial engine {OTHER}. Deterministic checks assist data preparation, while the actuary chooses methods, resolves exceptions and interprets the estimates; no production rates or reserve postings are committed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated reconciliation and scenario setup sit between source systems and actuarial analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured control checks and reusable engine inputs can reduce repeated preparation.
tasks.still_hard: A reconciled dataset can still be unsuitable for the chosen assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge uncertainty and challenge an apparently plausible liability estimate.

ambition.what: Evaluate an additional actuary-selected adverse development scenario before concluding the analysis.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-10; financial data access and applicable consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: actuarial engines and deterministic reconciliation checks can assist analysis preparation without replacing actuarial assumptions or sign-off.

assumptions: OTHER is the actuarial calculation engine. Boundary is analytical preparation and conclusions; rate deployment, reserve postings and formal report sends are separate actions not performed here.

Policy and claims owners supply existing extracts with policy ID, dates, exposure, claim values and valuation basis; finance supplies control totals. s1 performs reconciliation and manual exception resolution; absent or inconsistent fields stop the affected analysis.

Native imports and engine configuration first. Shares are unmeasured scenarios. s3 counts human input/scenario setup and review only; existing engine runtime was never human effort and earns no saving.
Gross 11 minus 2 upkeep gives 9 net. No model chooses assumptions, calculates liabilities or silently writes production values.
unknowns: Existing import controls and repeated configuration burden
research_questions: Which reconciliation and scenario setup actions are actually manual today and can be reused safely?

already_counted.description: Resolve reconciliation exceptions and review engine setup

incremental.description: Maintain source checks and scenario configurations after model changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native controls already cover preparation; up to 6% if exceptions reduce central 9% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Estimate event rates from statistical information

steps.what: Check exposure periods, event counts and cohort definitions in the statistical information
outputs: checked cohort information and data exceptions

steps.what: Select the estimation method and treatment of censoring, sparse cohorts and trend
inputs: checked cohort information and data exceptions

steps.what: Prepare cohort and parameter settings and estimate mortality, accident, sickness, disability and retirement rates with statistical software
inputs: checked cohort information and data exceptions

steps.what: Interpret fit diagnostics and uncertainty and decide whether estimated rates are usable
inputs: checked cohort information and data exceptions

tasks.design: Use deterministic exposure and cohort checks in {DATA_PLATFORM}, then reuse the actuary's chosen settings in statistical software {OTHER}. The actuary selects the method and assesses rate uncertainty; no generative model supplies event rates or method choices.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated cohort validation and parameter entry can slow recurring analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native statistical configurations and coded data checks can be reused.
tasks.still_hard: Sparse or changing cohorts can make a fitted rate misleading.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the data support the intended inference.

ambition.what: Compare a prespecified alternate cohort definition before accepting a rate estimate.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: statistical software computes rates from specified methods, while data and inference checks require actuarial judgement.

assumptions: OTHER is statistical estimation software. Boundary covers analysis and interpreted estimates, not publication or deployment of rate tables.

Data owners supply existing cohort keys, dates, exposure and event indicators with definitions. s1 checks completeness and invalid exposure; uncertain records require manual resolution, not inferred events.

Native configurations first. Shares are provisional. s3 reduction applies only to repeated human cohort/parameter setup; engine runtime and statistical calculation already performed by software receive no labour credit.
Gross 10.25 minus 2 upkeep yields 8.25 net. Shared data validation with premium/reserve analysis needs one owner at roll-up.
unknowns: Current repeat parameter-entry and cohort-check effort
research_questions: Can reusable specifications reduce actual setup work without concealing cohort changes?

already_counted.description: Check cohort exceptions and statistical configuration

incremental.description: Maintain validation rules and estimation configurations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero when configurations already exist; up to 5% when validation exceptions reduce central 8.25% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and review financially sound benefit plans

steps.what: Design or revise insurance, annuity and pension plan provisions against the intended benefit and funding objectives
Configure plan parameters and calculate premiums for the chosen alternatives in the actuarial engine
inputs: existing checked exposure and assumption inputs

steps.what: Review plan provisions, premiums and projections to determine financial soundness
outputs: financial soundness judgement and required design changes

steps.what: Help plan administrators interpret provisions and resolve actuarial questions arising in administration
inputs: administrators' actual benefit and premium questions
financial soundness judgement and required design changes
outputs: clarified actuarial treatment and unresolved administration issues

tasks.design: Configure reusable plan parameter sets in the actuarial engine {OTHER}, tied to provision versions in {DOCS}. The actuary retains plan design, financial-soundness review and interpretation for administrators; software neither changes live benefits nor issues plan amendments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated plan parameter entry sits alongside substantive design review.
tasks.enabler_now: Native versioned scenario configurations can reuse selected parameters.
tasks.still_hard: A provision's practical administration may expose a risk not visible in the projection.
tasks.human_edge: Connect financial projections to what the benefit promise means in practice.

ambition.what: No new product line or administration authority claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: actuarial engines can reuse plan scenario parameters, but plan design and financial soundness require actuarial judgement.

assumptions: Boundary covers design alternatives, calculation, review and advisory help in administration. Live benefit record changes, formal amendment publication and payment actions remain with their authorized administrative workflows; no such action is performed here.

Plan owner supplies provisions and objectives; actuary supplies selected alternatives in s1. Existing checked exposure and assumptions retain source/version references. Missing or incompatible inputs require manual resolution in s2; no free extraction is assumed.

Native parameter sets first. Provisional shares count human configuration, not engine runtime. Gross 3 minus 0.5 upkeep leaves 2.5 net; no saving is claimed for design, soundness review or administration discussions.
No separate plan-writing or approval baseline is invented beyond the design work itself. Roll-up must reconcile shared calculation preparation with other actuarial tasks.
unknowns: Actual parameter reuse and actuarial administration scope
research_questions: Does reusing plan settings reduce human configuration effort after provision-version checks?

incremental.description: Maintain plan parameter versions and regression examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if configuration is already reusable; up to 1.5% for smaller preparation gains than central 2.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on new or improved lines of business

steps.what: Collaborate with programmers, underwriters, accounts, claims experts and senior management to develop new lines of business or improve existing business
inputs: participants' current business, claims and implementation knowledge
outputs: shared understanding of business options, constraints and actuarial questions

tasks.design: Keep cross-functional development discussion with the actuary and colleagues. A reference view in {PROJECT} can support another task but does not replace negotiation of business and implementation constraints here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each discipline sees different risks and practical constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing collaboration tools carry information without resolving the substantive choices.
tasks.still_hard: Agree which business option is both useful and supportable.
tasks.human_edge: Translate actuarial uncertainty for colleagues and challenge an attractive but weak proposal.

ambition.what: No capacity-funded new line of business claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: cross-functional business development requires contextual discussion and professional judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is the stated collaboration. It establishes no separate authored business plan, minutes, record write or send; no administrative baseline is invented.
Inputs are participants' actual knowledge and objectives; no new structured input contract is required. Native project references do not replace this discussion.
No software change means zero upkeep. The full retained share denotes the whole task, not an observed duration.
unknowns: Whether the local collaboration includes a distinct written options paper
research_questions: Observe whether an actual document write should be separated from the meeting.

incremental.description: No introduced software or recording process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Substantive cross-functional collaboration stays fully retained; no separate administrative work is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Actuaries retain method choice, interpretation and business advice; reusable controls and calculation configurations reduce repeated preparation.
skills_to_grow: Separate human setup effort from engine runtime
role.ambitious_version: Test an additional adverse or alternate-cohort scenario with traceable inputs before accepting an actuarial conclusion.
